title: ‘Convicted or not convicted’: Wasim Akram breaks silence on Imran Khan’s health
content: Wasim Akram expressed worry about Imran Khan's health and legal situation. He stated that health concerns should not be compromised by legal proceedings. Akram spoke from the heart as a worried friend, not a politician. International captains have also called for humane treatment and proper medical care. Imran's sons voiced fears for their father's safety in prison.

title: Husband died in 2006, widow got PF and gratuity; why HC rejected pension claim
content: On April 27, 2010, Bank of Maharashtra introduced a one-time option allowing a specified category of serving employees, retired employees and families of deceased employees to join the Pension Scheme, subject to the prescribed terms and conditions.

title: How WhatsApp messages led to former USCIS official in $960,000 citizenship scam
content: A former USCIS official and an accomplice face federal charges for a bribery scheme. They allegedly accepted nearly $960,000 to manipulate immigration applications. Investigators used thousands of WhatsApp messages and calls to trace the alleged scam. The scheme involved bypassing standard procedures and speeding up citizenship cases. This alleged operation spanned over six years, from late 2019 to early 2026.

title: 5.3-magnitude quake hits Tibet as region reels from deadly flash floods
content: A magnitude 5.3 earthquake struck Tibet recently, following another tremor last week.  Devastating flash floods hit the Tibet-Nepal border on August 26, causing widespread destruction.  The disaster has raised concerns over the fragile Qinghai-Tibet Plateau environment.  Rising temperatures and glacier melt are cited as contributing factors to the floods.  Nepal's death toll from the floods has risen to 1,357 people.

title: Uber's layoff memo also has a work from home message for remaining 29,000 employees
content: Uber is cutting about 3,300 jobs, roughly 10% of its workforce, but chief executive Dara Khosrowshahi's email to staff carries a second decision for everyone who stays. Uber is ending work from home for all but 1% of employees, asking remote staff to move to an office near their team. The three-day hybrid policy stays, and Uber will enforce it, with global teams concentrated in New York and San Francisco.

title: Babar breaks silence on PCB’s mid-series shake-up, says 'it was news to me as well'
content: Babar Azam, the captain of the Pakistan cricket team, voiced his astonishment over the recent changes made to the squad. He revealed that the Pakistan Cricket Board made these decisions independently, without consulting him. Following recent losses, seven players were axed, and the coaching staff saw modifications as well. Azam assured his fitness to lead the team in the upcoming final Test against England with a notably reshaped roster.

title: Scientists seeded clouds over Chinese glacier; ice loss later fell up to 17%
content: Scientists tested cloud seeding over China’s Muz Taw Glacier in 2018 to create artificial snowfall and slow ice loss. The experiment used silver iodide generators to encourage snow formation. Researchers found that fresh snow made the glacier surface brighter and reduced the amount of ice lost over a short period. However, they said the results are preliminary and need further testing.

title: Andrew Flintoff lists £6.75m Cheshire mansion 4 years after crash
content: England cricket legend Andrew Flintoff has put his £6.75 million Cheshire mansion on the market, four years after his life-changing Top Gear car crash. Bought from former Manchester United star Phil Neville in 2021, the 10,000 sq ft luxury property features six bedrooms, six bathrooms, four floors, a pool, gym, cinema and games room.

title: AI boom puts US universities under pressure; GWU Virginia campus sale shows why
content: American universities are increasingly selling land to data centers for AI infrastructure projects. George Washington University sold its Virginia campus to Amazon Data Services for significant funds. This sale aims to strengthen the university's long-term financial position and support academic missions. The University of Michigan is building its own AI computing center for research purposes. Local opposition has arisen regarding the University of Michigan's large facility plans.

title: Meet Monika Arya, who fought for education and now helps tribal children
content: Monika Arya’s journey from a village in Uttar Pradesh to working with tribal children in Jharkhand is rooted in her own interrupted education. After facing family resistance to college and spending nearly 12 years away from formal studies, she returned to complete her MSc. In 2021, she founded Sambhav Trust in Khunti, focusing on education, child protection, scholarships, career guidance and safe migration to help vulnerable children remain in school and build better futures.

title: Stephen Curry recalls his parents crying for him: What happened?
content: Stephen Curry, the Golden State Warriors' star player, opens up about the moment he saw both his parents crying for him.

title: LeBron James on his father: Why has he never met him?
content: LeBron James, the NBA icon, has refletced on why never having a father in his life shaped the success he has today.

title: T20 leagues taking over? Ponting fears ODI cricket will be 'played less'
content: Ricky Ponting expresses concern over the potential decline of ODI cricket as T20 leagues gain popularity worldwide. He views this shift as an unavoidable part of the sport's evolution, which leaves him disheartened about the future of 50-over matches. Despite this, Ponting remains optimistic that Test cricket will thrive, as major cricketing nations continue to value the longest format.

title: Flipkart widens lead against Amazon as quick commerce surges
content: Flipkart is growing its user base faster than Amazon in India.  This expands its lead in online retail significantly over recent years.  Flipkart's quick-commerce business, Flipkart Minutes, is also scaling up rapidly.  It is now handling millions of orders daily, nearing established rivals.  The company's user base growth contrasts with Amazon's contracting numbers.

title: Hong Kong or Singapore: Which country should expats choose in 2026?
content: Hong Kong and Singapore compete as Asia's top financial hubs, offering expat opportunities.  Singapore provides a more spacious and structured environment for residents.  Hong Kong offers a faster-paced, denser urban experience with strong China connections.  Career opportunities vary, with Hong Kong strong in finance and Singapore in tech.  Both cities attract wealthy foreigners for housing, wealth management, and luxury sales.

title: Ranveer-Deepika share adorable pics with Dua on her 2nd birthday
content: Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone captured beautiful family moments featuring their daughter Dua. In stunning black-and-white shots, Deepika celebrated her baby bump while Dua charmed viewers with her delightful antics. Ranveer took to Instagram, sharing these intimate snapshots alongside expressions of gratitude for their blessings. These precious images give fans a heartwarming preview of Dua stepping into her new role as a big sister.

title: ‘Back to blue’: Hockey India reverses saffron jersey decision for Asiad after uproar
content: Hockey India has made a noteworthy change, reverting to the classic blue kits for both the men's and women's teams ahead of the Asian Games. This decision comes after considerable criticism regarding the earlier saffron jersey plan. With the stakes high for Olympic qualification, the teams will prioritise blue, though saffron will still serve as a secondary choice if needed.

title: Does AfD's big win in Germany signal a 'far right' uprising in Europe?
content: Many years ago, Otto von Bismarck observed that politics was “the art of the possible”. The modern European establishment appears to have inverted the Iron Chancellor’s maxim. Politics has increasingly become the art of explaining to voters why what they want is impossible, irresponsible, xenophobic, Islamophobic, nativist or, inevitably, far right. And made it impossible to vote for the so-called far-right party that’s actually willing to admit there’s a problem.

title: Channi vs Warring: Why Sachin Pilot may be Congress's best bet in Punjab

With a wealth of experience from Rajasthan, Pilot faces the challenging task of overcoming anti-incumbency against the ruling AAP government. His triumph here may pave the way for a more significant role back in Rajasthan.

title: 'Will also kill her sugar daddy': Guwahati man who beheaded wife, kept head in fridge

The accused surrendered to police after the incident occurred on September third.  He confessed to the crime, stating frequent arguments led to the fatal act.  A court has sent the accused to police custody for seven days.

Their friendship has grown since they met in Tunisia. Now, Andreeva is set to take on Coco Gauff in the quarterfinals, illustrating a beautiful blend of competitive edge and the warmth of sportsmanship.

This recommendation was upheld by the Cauvery Water Management Authority. Karnataka officials cited declining water inflows and drinking water needs. The state government is seriously considering filing a petition soon.

His experience and leadership on the field are now seen as essential assets for navigating his royal responsibilities.
